statement: CoreWeave scaled active data center capacity from roughly 70 megawatts at the end of 2023 to about 1.5 gigawatts by mid-2026.
why: Live capacity is the physical base for rentable GPU compute, so a build-out of this size adds non-hyperscaler supply of AI compute to the market.

impact.mechanism: More energized data-center capacity means more installed GPUs available for rent, expanding alternative compute supply outside the large clouds.

evidence.excerpt: CoreWeave has scaled active data center capacity from roughly 70 megawatts (MW) at the end of 2023 to about 1.5 GW by mid-2026.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; capacity figures are approximations given without a company source in the document.
